title: Still Too Hot for Me...  Nice, Quality Duvet but Not the Coolest
text:
Still Too Hot for Me... Nice, Quality Duvet but Not the Coolest. I love the concept of a duvet and duvet cover set. It makes laundering so much easier when all that is required is removal of the cover, washing that and replacing rather than washing and drying an entire comforter.

My issue has always been, and remains, finding a duvet that is actually light enough where I’m not hot all night long. I simply don’t sleep well when I’m hot and I tend to get hot during the night. I turn the air down, the fan is on, I have cooling sheets and try to find the lightest coverings possible as to not wake covered in sweat.

This duvet certainly isn’t as hot as others I have tried but I would not classify it as cool either. I thought based on how thin this duvet insert is it would be cooler - I am completely fine with it having less fill if that means I stay cooler. After using it for a month I’ve found even this one is too hot for me...

When it arrived I thought this duvet had real promise based on appearance as it is really thin. I washed it and it laundered without any issue. I attached it within our duvet cover and it has remained in place perfectly well.

This is a quality product and I will plan on using it in the winter. I’ve continued researching and it appears natural down may be my best bet in finding something that will help me stay cool. While that seems a bit counterintuitive it appears it’s a matter of how the nature of the feathers actually work. I’ve ordered another so I shall see. My hunt continues.
